title: Coin Costs Ended The Penny And Put The Nickel On Notice
hook: Pocket change now costs more to make than its face value.
closing: Ending the penny solves one coin loss while the nickel problem remains.
question: Would you miss the penny?

segments.say: The penny program lost 86 million dollars yearly. Ending production turns that recurring loss into savings.
The penny lasted 232 years. Its unusually long production run finally ends under mounting cost pressure.
A nickel costs 13.78 cents to produce. The next coin problem is already larger than its face value.
